scripts.dev:auth: npm run build:shared && dotenv -e .env -- npm -w services/auth-service run dev
scripts.dev:account: npm run build:shared && dotenv -e .env -- npm -w services/account-service run dev
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared  && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently -n auth,account -c auto "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:account"
